Welcome

Welcome to the
Town of Exet er Online Assessment Database.

The Town has completed a statistical revaluation for the assessment date 12/31/2023. The values indicated on this site reflect the market conditions as of 12/31/2023.

The Ownership data contained on this site is updated weekly , f or current
ownership information, contact the Tax Assessor’s Office or visit USLANDRECORDS.COM

The assessed
valuations on this site do not reflect any tax exemptions or tax stabilization
agreements that may be applicable.

The Exeter Tax
Assessor’s Office makes every effort to produce and publish the most accurate
information available; however, the Office assumes no responsibility for errors
in the data and does not guarantee that the information is free from
inaccuracies.

Property
owners are encouraged to check the accuracy of the detail section of their
property description. Please contact our office with any discrepancies.

The
Town of Exeter Tax Assessors' Office is located at 675 Ten Rod Rd, Exeter, RI
02822, Office hours are 9:00 am to 4:00pm Monday through Friday.

T elephone 401-294-5734.

Ema il: Taxassessor@exeterri.gov [mailto:Taxassessor@town.exeter.ri.us]
